title: Traceability Analysis with r4subtrace
text: direct ADaM--SDTM mapping simplest case. Many variables derived ADaM variables derived SDTM. single hop misses links. trace_chains() follows full path back source, using adam_derivations table ADaM--ADaM steps. ADTTE.TAGE three hops source, fully grounded: chain reaches DM.AGE. trace_depth argument caps far walk follows chain, circular derivations detected reported rather looping forever.
code: adam <- data.frame(   dataset  = c("ADSL", "ADAE", "ADTTE"),   variable = c("AGE", "AAGE", "TAGE"),   label    = c("Age", "Analysis Age", "Time-to-event Age") ) sdtm <- data.frame(dataset = "DM", variable = "AGE", label = "Age") map  <- data.frame(   adam_dataset = "ADSL", adam_var = "AGE",   sdtm_domain = "DM", sdtm_var = "AGE", confidence = 1 ) tmc <- build_trace_model(adam, sdtm, mapping = map)  deriv <- data.frame(   from_dataset = c("ADAE", "ADTTE"),   from_var     = c("AAGE", "TAGE"),   to_dataset   = c("ADSL", "ADAE"),   to_var       = c("AGE", "AAGE") )  trace_chains(tmc, adam_derivations = deriv) #> # A tibble: 3 × 9 #>   adam_dataset adam_var max_depth grounded terminal_source has_cycle truncated #>   <chr>        <chr>        <int> <lgl>    <chr>           <lgl>     <lgl>     #> 1 ADSL         AGE              1 TRUE     DM.AGE          FALSE     FALSE     #> 2 ADAE         AAGE             2 TRUE     DM.AGE          FALSE     FALSE     #> 3 ADTTE        TAGE             3 TRUE     DM.AGE          FALSE     FALSE     #> # ℹ 2 more variables: n_paths <int>, longest_chain <chr>

title: Follow Multi-Step Derivation Chains — trace_chains
text: Traces ADaM variable back ultimate source chains depth, just single ADaM--SDTM hop. Real submissions often derive ADaM variable another ADaM variable derived SDTM (example ADAE variable built ADSL, turn comes DM). Shallow tracing misses links understates coverage.

title: Follow Multi-Step Derivation Chains — trace_chains

title: Follow Multi-Step Derivation Chains — trace_chains
text: tibble one row per ADaM variable: adam_dataset, adam_var, max_depth (longest chain hops), grounded (path reaches SDTM), terminal_source, has_cycle, truncated (path hit trace_depth), n_paths, longest_chain (readable path string).

title: Follow Multi-Step Derivation Chains — trace_chains
text: ADaM--SDTM links come trace model's edges. ADaM--ADaM links supplied adam_derivations, data.frame columns from_dataset, from_var, to_dataset, to_var, derived variable source. ADaM variable walked toward sources path reaches SDTM variable (grounded), dead-ends ADaM variable source (ungrounded), revisits node (cycle), reaches trace_depth hops.

title: Follow Multi-Step Derivation Chains — trace_chains
code: adam <- data.frame(   dataset = c("ADSL", "ADAE"), variable = c("AGE", "AAGE"),   label = c("Age", "Analysis Age") ) sdtm <- data.frame(dataset = "DM", variable = "AGE", label = "Age") map <- data.frame(   adam_dataset = "ADSL", adam_var = "AGE",   sdtm_domain = "DM", sdtm_var = "AGE", confidence = 1 ) tm <- build_trace_model(adam, sdtm, mapping = map) deriv <- data.frame(   from_dataset = "ADAE", from_var = "AAGE",   to_dataset = "ADSL", to_var = "AGE" ) trace_chains(tm, adam_derivations = deriv) #> # A tibble: 2 × 9 #>   adam_dataset adam_var max_depth grounded terminal_source has_cycle truncated #>   <chr>        <chr>        <int> <lgl>    <chr>           <lgl>     <lgl>     #> 1 ADSL         AGE              1 TRUE     DM.AGE          FALSE     FALSE     #> 2 ADAE         AAGE             2 TRUE     DM.AGE          FALSE     FALSE     #> # ℹ 2 more variables: n_paths <int>, longest_chain <chr>

code: adam <- data.frame(   dataset = c("ADSL", "ADAE"), variable = c("AGE", "AAGE"),   label = c("Age", "Analysis Age") ) sdtm <- data.frame(dataset = "DM", variable = "AGE", label = "Age") map <- data.frame(   adam_dataset = "ADSL", adam_var = "AGE",   sdtm_domain = "DM", sdtm_var = "AGE", confidence = 1 ) tm <- build_trace_model(adam, sdtm, mapping = map) deriv <- data.frame(   from_dataset = "ADAE", from_var = "AAGE",   to_dataset = "ADSL", to_var = "AGE" ) # If DM.AGE changes, what is affected? trace_impact(tm, "DM.AGE", adam_derivations = deriv) #> # A tibble: 2 × 5 #>   dataset variable role  depth path                            #>   <chr>   <chr>    <chr> <int> <chr>                           #> 1 ADSL    AGE      adam      1 ADSL.AGE -> DM.AGE              #> 2 ADAE    AAGE     adam      2 ADAE.AAGE -> ADSL.AGE -> DM.AGE
